proposed.text: What does NSCP Section 605.2 require for wood embedded in the ground or in direct earth contact when it supports permanent structures?

options.text: It shall be treated wood unless continuously below the ground waterline or submerged in fresh water.
It may be untreated if it is hidden by concrete.
It requires only a paint coating.
It is allowed only for temporary structures.

rationale.correct: Section 605.2 requires treated wood for wood embedded in the ground or in direct earth contact supporting permanent structures, unless continuously below the ground waterline or submerged in fresh water.
rationale.takeaway: Ground-contact support is a treatment trigger in Section 605.
